info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Cancel Logistics Shipments API allows users to terminate existing shipment requests seamlessly. This endpoint is essential for logistics managers and shipping coordinators who need to manage shipment statuses effectively. By invoking this operation, consumers can efficiently remove shipments from the processing queue, reducing overhead and improving operational efficiency. This API serves as a critical tool for businesses managing logistics operations, ensuring that resources are optimized and aligned with customer needs.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing shipment. Please provide the necessary shipment identification details to successfully cancel the shipment.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a shipment. This operation allows the user to specify details about the shipment they wish to cancel, ensuring that the appropriate actions are taken on the shipment process.

200.description: The shipment cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling shipments operations via a DELETE request. It is currently defined as a simple string.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the shipment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the shipment after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation process.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for the successful cancellation of a shipment.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information for the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
